# Project intake

| Field | Project value |
| --- | --- |
| System / agency / mission | UNRESOLVED |
| System owner / ISSO / AO | UNRESOLVED |
| Assessment purpose / environment | UNRESOLVED |
| Classification / information types | UNRESOLVED |
| Authorization boundary / external services | UNRESOLVED |
| Approved baseline / catalog revision / tailoring | UNRESOLVED |
| Agency template version | UNRESOLVED |
| Application and configuration revisions | UNRESOLVED |
| Package path / evidence root / claim manifest | UNRESOLVED |
| Evidence storage, access and retention | UNRESOLVED |
| Permitted local/live actions and test data | UNRESOLVED |
| Toolkit revision / interpreter / optional environment | UNRESOLVED |
| Work register / decision record location | UNRESOLVED |

For every unresolved item, record an owner, blocking dependency and pickup trigger
in the project's work register. Intake is not baseline or authorization approval.
